hero.title: AegisFlow

metrics.methodology: Unit-NAV removes external cash flows before calculating returns.
cards.nonCustodialBody: Your assets remain in your OKX account. Trading permissions can still cause losses.
cards.circuitBody: Risk events are published with UTC time, source hash and measurement details.

security.title: API security controls
security.transfer: AegisFlow does not call transfer endpoints. OKX Trade permission may allow internal transfers.
security.ip: Copy the server egress IP and add it to your OKX API whitelist.
security.probeTrade: [ ] Read and perpetual swap trade permissions verified
security.probeTransfer: [i] AegisFlow does not call transfer endpoints; OKX Trade permission may allow internal transfers.
security.encryption: AES-256-GCM envelope encryption is applied before credentials are stored.
security.tls: TLS 1.3 is a deployment requirement. Confirm it at the edge before enabling production sign-in.
security.logs: Application routes do not log request bodies; proxy and crash reporting must also exclude them.
risk.title: Risk disclosure
risk.copy: Perpetual swaps are volatile. Leverage can magnify losses, including loss of margin. Historical results are not a return guarantee.
market.title: Market risk snapshot
market.copy: Data is shown only when a timestamped public feed is available. This page is not an execution offer or return forecast.
market.riskCopy: Trading perpetual swaps can lose value. A circuit breaker cannot eliminate market, liquidity or execution risk.
footer.disclaimer: Software and analytics only. Not an investment adviser, broker, custodian or return guarantee.
